title: Gardien bu màndarga Yàlla
intro: Ci biir barab bu sell, ruuh bu barkeel lañu daan dundal ci ndigalu Yàlla. Nit kooku dafa wara def liggéey bu am solo ci xew-xew bu yéeme, nekk seede ci doole ak xam-xam bu amul àpp bu Yàlla. Seen tukki dafa wane dëgg gu xóot, di jafeel gis-gis yi, di wane màndarga bu amul fenn ci doomi aadama yépp.
clues: Yàlla tànn nama, sellal ma ci sama jamono jigeen yépp.
Dañu ma yóbbu ci loxo benn yonent bu jub, mu am luñu ma jox ci sama néegu ñaan ci anam wu yéeme.
Ma génne sama bopp ci sama njaboot, dem ci barab bu kenn xamul ngir jaamu Yàlla.
Malaaka feeñu ma ci melokaanu nit ku mat sëkk, di wax ma doom ju sell, doonte musu ma xamante ak góor.
Ginaaw metit wi may am doom, ñu sant ma yëngal yaramam garabu palme ngir am luñu ma lekk.
Bima delloo ci samay mbokk yor sama doom juy sooga judd, ñu laaj ma, waaye sama doom ju ndaw ji wax ci sama berso ci kéemtaanu Yàlla ngir jàppale ma.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Mbënd mu réy mu yàq xeet wu weddi woon
Ñu sànni leen ci safara suy tàkk ndax weddi nañu xërëm yi
Juddug xale bu amul pàppa ci anam wu yéeme
Baleine wann la ndax danga bàyyi misioŋ
Yaxxum dëkk ngir jëf yu ñaaw
trial.answer: Juddug xale bu amul pàppa ci anam wu yéeme

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Xaajalug géej gi ngir askan wi jàll
Xale bu wax ci berso ngir jàppale seen waajur
Wañug téereb Yàlla ngir jiite nit ñi
Nguur gu barkeel ngelaw ak jinne
outcome.answer: Xale bu wax ci berso ngir jàppale seen waajur

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds. (3:42)
